verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core interaction model IS a documented public Python API (Agent/Task/Crew/Flow/LLM/Tools/Memory classes) plus a documented CLI (crewai create/run/train/test), giving AI-native users a fully programmatic way to drive the product without a UI; Enterprise/AMP also exposes deployed crews via REST API and webhook streaming. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s at standard paths) and REST API access is gated to the paid Enterprise/AMP tier rather than the open-source core.
